decisions.decision: Qualification uses actual inherited compiler/courts/controller/agent; no alternate decision simulator.
Keep all original runtime and constitutional bytes; additive finite T5 foundry.
Use public fixture signers and temporary SQLite only; no actual issuer, cloud, deployment or native P/PPI.
Bind initial frozen milestones; expose post-exploratory corpus serialization and same-author oracle limits.
Separate static trace inspection, pure controller journal replay and fresh scenario execution.
T6 platform/release gates and native P/PPI remain separate, no productivity claim.
